Post-merger integration in the first 100 days

An acquisition that is not integrated in its first hundred days rarely is. We run the integration office: the day-one plan, the operating-model decisions, the ERP cutover and the combined sales coverage, with a weekly scorecard for the board.

What you get

  • A day-one plan and a 100-day plan with named owners.
  • One chart of accounts, one ERP instance, one price list.
  • Synergies tracked against the deal model every week.
